fields.FIR_Description: As per the FIR recorded on 2025-09-04, goods ordered from a website for Rs. 24,000 were not delivered, and the seller could not be reached. The time of the incident was given as 13:05 on 2025-09-03. The complaint was lodged by Kalaiselvi Devi (9000000121). The complaint refers to Jagan Velan, a business acquaintance, reachable on 9000000339. The account reference SYN-ACC-100013 was noted in connection with the payment. No independent witness was identified at the time of registration. The complainant alleged that Sathish Sundaram may be involved and provided the mobile number 9000000372. No supporting material was reported at the time of registration.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Victim reportedly paid in advance and was blocked by the seller.
fields.Keywords: online shopping fraud, fake seller, afternoon, college road, receiving account, suspect, associate, mobile number
